## Goal
Explain the matcher for contributors: fields compared, nickname and suffix handling, age ranges, what makes a match 'confirmed' versus 'possible', and why the app never auto-confirms on one weak field. Cite file:line.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Table of fields and their weight with citations.
2. Worked examples with fake people (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL).
3. A 'what to change and what to test' checklist for contributors.
4. Every citation resolves (WO-255 guard, once merged, passes).

Docs/tests-only work in Codex's lane. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL), offline, Windows-safe paths. Check `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

- `docs/dev/MATCHING.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

Every file not listed above.
